newsitem.title: USA: Aero Systems looks for 1997 profit after Q4 loss.
newsitem.headline: Aero Systems looks for 1997 profit after Q4 loss.

text.p: Aero Systems Engineering Inc said Thursday it is optimistic it will show a profit in 1997 after reporting a loss for the fourth quarter of 1996.
The engine testing systems developer said it lost $659,000, or $0.26 a share, in the period ended December 31, versus a profit of $820,000, or $0.32 a share, in the fourth quarter of 1995.
Sales fell to $4.6 million from $8.4 million, Aero said.
The company said 1996 featured several disappointing events, including the cancellation of the National Wind Tunnel Complex project and the loss of several bidding competitions.
However, changes in its marketing approach resulted in several major new contracts in early 1997, the company said.
